name: llm-wiki-compiler
description: Compile knowledge files or codebases into topic-based wikis that agents can read before raw sources.

interface.shortDescription: Compile project knowledge into agent-readable wikis
interface.longDescription: LLM Wiki Compiler turns scattered markdown files or codebase knowledge into topic-based wiki articles with coverage indicators, source backlinks, schema evolution, and a knowledge graph. In Codex, use the bundled skill through natural-language prompts rather than Claude slash commands.
defaultPrompt: Capture this in my wiki: https://example.com
Compile changed sources into the wiki
